editorial.thesis: A motor-trade-and-hospitality city of about 888,000. Its retail is heavy on desserts, sweets & ice cream and grocery & daily needs, and thin on apparel, footwear & jewellery and fitness & wellness — and 33% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 46% of Jaipur's. 9.35 chain outlets per lakh residents against 20.27 in Jaipur; 27 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Café Coffee Day 10, Domino's 8, Raymond 7.

The mapped economy leans to desserts & sweets. Shares of all mapped places: desserts & sweets 0.9% (Jaipur 0.7%); automotive 4.1% (Jaipur 3.0%); healthcare 6.6% (Jaipur 9.3%); offices 9.3% (Jaipur 12.2%). Raw counts would mislead because Jaipur is mapped more completely (38,142 places against 9,739), so we compare mix, not counts.

Supply and demand are misaligned. 5 zones hold 33% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Kum Bhagat Ki Kothi alone has about 116,000 residents and 33 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Jaipur. 48% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Jaipur 43%). The largest cores are Kabutaron Ka Chowk · City (2,285 places) and Shastri Nagar · Chopasni Road (1,287).

The widest brand gaps against Jaipur. Apollo Pharmacy 6 outlets vs 70; Café Coffee Day 10 outlets vs 43; Raymond 7 outlets vs 30. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 8 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Jaipur, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Kabutaron Ka Chowk · City and Kum Bhagat Ki Kothi are the largest zones by residents (209,000 and 116,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 48% of all commercial places, and Kabutaron Ka Chowk · City alone lists 2,285.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Kabutaron Ka Chowk · City holds 29 of the 83 tracked chain outlets, and Shastri Nagar · Chopasni Road adds 23.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Kabutaron Ka Chowk · City and Subhash Nagar lead on education places (252 and 117, with 95 and 36 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Kum Bhagat Ki Kothi and Kum Mandore Road. The blue cores include Kabutaron Ka Chowk · City.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (38,142 places in Jaipur against 9,739 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Jaipur; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Jaipur, Jodhpur's mapped places over-index on desserts & sweets (0.9% vs 0.7%), automotive (4.1% vs 3.0%), grocery & daily needs (1.7% vs 1.3%) and under-index on healthcare (6.6% vs 9.3%), offices (9.3% vs 12.2%), leisure & entertainment (3.0% vs 3.4%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 83 outlets of 27 tracked national brands within 8 km — 9.35 per lakh residents against Jaipur's 20.27 (448 outlets of 39 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Jaipur are Apollo Pharmacy (6 vs 70); Café Coffee Day (10 vs 43); Raymond (7 vs 30). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Jaipur's, so low means thin by Jaipur's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 8 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Jodhpur's age mix against Jaipur: children (0–14) 32.7% vs 27.9%, 15–24 19.5% vs 21.1%, working age 40.8% vs 44.1%, 60+ 7.0% vs 6.9%. Under-25s are 52% of residents.

zones.342005: An under-served zone: about 116,000 residents, 540 mapped places, 33 food & drink and 3 chain outlets. Depth index 57.

zones.342006: A student-and-family belt: 96 education places (36 coaching) and 59 healthcare places for about 86,000 residents, with 56 food & drink places and 4 chain outlets.
zones.342003: A commercial core: 1,287 mapped places and 23 chain outlets (28% of the city's tracked chains) for about 81,000 residents. A destination zone, so much of its footfall likely lives elsewhere.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.2% of mapped places against 4.9% in Jaipur, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 8 (Jaipur 30), Pizza Hut 4 (Jaipur 19), Subway 3 (Jaipur 12), McDonald's 1 (Jaipur 10). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 3.1% of mapped places against 2.9% in Jaipur, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 10 (Jaipur 43), Starbucks 1 (Jaipur 5), Chai Sutta Bar 1 (Jaipur 4). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.9% of mapped places against 0.7% in Jaipur — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 4 (Jaipur 25), Havmor 3 (Jaipur 7). No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.7% of mapped places against 1.3% in Jaipur — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 6 (Jaipur 26), DMart 1 (Jaipur 10), Big Bazaar 1 (Jaipur 5), Vishal Mega Mart 1 (Jaipur 7). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 1.2% of mapped places against 1.0% in Jaipur — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 6 (Jaipur 70). No mapped outlet in either city: MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 6.6% of mapped places against 7.1% in Jaipur, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Raymond 7 (Jaipur 30), Reliance Trends 6 (Jaipur 11), Bata 4 (Jaipur 21), Tanishq 3 (Jaipur 9).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 7.1% of mapped places against 7.3% in Jaipur, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 3.5% of mapped places against 3.3% in Jaipur, so the mix is level.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 3.4% of mapped places against 3.7% in Jaipur, so the mix is level.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
